51121693.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to N-terminal His6-tagged recombinant human Brd4 BD2 expressed in Escherichia coli BL21 (DE3) assessed as compound binary complex formation by isothermal titration calorimetry-based assay

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC) experiments were performed using a MicroCal iTC200 instrument (Malvern Panalytical, Worcestershire, UK). The protein (Brd2, Brd3, or Brd4 BD1 or BD2) was dialyzed against 20 mM HEPES, 150 mM NaCl, 1 mM DTT, pH 7.5, and concentrated to 100–200 μM. The compound (10) or VCB was dissolved in DMSO and diluted in the same buffer to a final concentration of 1–2 mM. The protein was loaded into the sample cell (200 μL), and the compound was loaded into the syringe (200 μL). The experiment was performed at 25°C with a stirring speed of 750 rpm. The compound was injected in 20 aliquots of 2 μL each, with a 120 s spacing between injections. The first injection was 0.4 μL. The data were analyzed using Origin 7.0 software (OriginLab, Northampton, MA, USA) with a one-site binding model. The binding affinity (Kd) was calculated from the fitted curve. The experiments were performed in duplicate, except for VCB into 10, which was performed in quadruplicate. The values reported are the mean ± s.e.m.

51121705.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to human BRD4 expressed in Escherichia coli BL21(DE3)-R3-pRARE2 cells by isothermal titration calorimetry-based assay

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC) experiments were performed using a MicroCal iTC200 instrument (Malvern Panalytical, Worcestershire, UK). The protein (BET bromodomain) was dialyzed against 20 mM HEPES, 150 mM NaCl, 1 mM DTT, pH 7.5, and concentrated to 100–200 μM. The ligand (Compound 10 or VCB) was dissolved in DMSO and diluted in the same buffer to a final concentration of 1–2 mM. The protein was loaded into the sample cell (200 μL), and the ligand was loaded into the syringe (200 μL). The experiment was performed at 25°C with a stirring speed of 750 rpm. A total of 20 injections were made, each of 2 μL, with a 120 s spacing between injections. The first injection was 0.4 μL to minimize dilution effects. The data were analyzed using Origin 7.0 software (OriginLab, Northampton, MA, USA) with a one-site binding model. The binding affinity (Kd), enthalpy (ΔH), entropy (ΔS), and stoichiometry (N) were determined. The experiments were performed in duplicate, except for VCB into 10, which was performed in quadruplicate. The buffer used for dialysis and dilution was 20 mM HEPES, 150 mM NaCl, 1 mM DTT, pH 7.5.
